# RoutineForge

> AI automation and digital systems for modern businesses.

RoutineForge designs AI phone agents, chatbots, workflow automation, custom AI systems, and high-performance websites — built around your processes and connected to the tools your team already uses.

## Services

- **AI Phone Agent:** Never miss a lead. Every call gets answered and a next step is determined.
- **AI Chatbot:** Sales, customer support, and appointment booking available 24/7.
- **AI Automation:** Custom workflows and integrations so processes can run themselves.
- **Custom AI Systems:** Tailored AI solutions built specifically around your unique business operations.
- **Web Development:** High-performance, fast-loading websites optimized for search engines, AI discovery, and conversions.

## Industries Served

We provide tailored solutions for various sectors, including:
- **Dental Practices:** Booking, reminders, CRM, and patient communication.
- **Travel Agencies:** Faster replies, package sales, and traveller reactivation.
- **Law Firms:** Drafting, internal search, automation, and AI training.
- **Hotels & Hospitality:** Guest apps, direct bookings, and connected shifts.
- **Instagram Shops:** Sales, orders, and follow-up directly inside DMs.
- **Real Estate:** Qualified buyers, viewing booking, and an active CRM.
- **Service Businesses:** Fewer interruptions, faster answers, and repair tracking.
- **E-commerce:** 24/7 sales, cart recovery, and automated support.
